welcome: Review the old, learn the new — drill panel under construction
totalTimeHint: Total drilling time of this document
noExerciseDocs: No generated exercise sets yet — click "AI: make questions" above to create one
quizNone: No question blocks in this document (maybe not generated, or deleted)
convertDialogHint: Paste the id of the note to turn into questions. The AI first reports whether it is suitable, then generates a "Title·习题" document.
thoughtPlaceholder: Jot down your reasoning (optional) — the AI review will comment on it
convertEmptyReply: AI returned an empty reply (document too large or model timeout); retry or split the document
convertTimeout: Conversion timed out (over 5 minutes), please retry
convertRefused: AI judged this document unsuitable for questions
convertNoQuestions: AI returned no valid question blocks
timeUp: Time is up — you can still answer
settingShowNumsDesc: Show the question-number rail on the left of the quiz area; click a number to jump to that question
answeredPending: Answered — revealed when all questions are done
convertTargetHint: Where the exercise doc is created
convertTargetDocHint: Used when 'Under a chosen parent doc': doc id or siyuan:// link
convertTargetMissing: Target parent doc not found — check the doc id
setModelHint: The convert dialog preselects this model; you can still change it per run
setAboutText: Turn note docs into quizzes: pick progress/reveal/timing before each round. Rounds, wrong counts and time persist (block attrs + plugin data). See docs/question-block-contract.md.
settingShowAttemptsDesc: Show "drilled N times" on the card head
settingShowWrongDesc: Show wrong-count badge and colored question numbers from last round; hidden automatically in reveal-after-all mode to avoid spoilers
setDefaultHint: Initial choice on the start panel; change per round anytime
continueHint: Continue = resume that round as-is (timing/reveal/scope locked); pick Start over to change config ({n} answered)
scopeHint: All questions, or only the ones you got wrong last round
revealHint: When to reveal answers and solutions after grading
fillToChoiceHint: Rewrite fill-in-the-blank questions as single-choice: original answer correct + 3 distractors by AI
fillToChoiceDesc: Rewrite fill-in-blank questions as single-choice during conversion (AI distractors); toggle per run in the dialog
bigToStepsHint: Rewrite decomposable STEM questions as guided steps (method + intermediate results, unlocked step by step)
bigToStepsDesc: Rewrite decomposable STEM questions as guided steps during conversion (method/result steps); essays and proofs stay brief; toggle per run in the dialog
stepsModeHint: How guided-step questions are answered this round (other types unaffected)
